description: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new date and time. Sends updated SMS and email confirmations automatically. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'reschedule_booking' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' or 'get_gestational_guide' for their respective operations). Parameters: booking_id (required), new_date (required), new_time (required). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

booking_id.description: The booking record ID [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

new_date.description: New appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-09-20")

new_time.description: New appointment start time in HH:MM format (e.g. "11:00")

name: reschedule_booking
title: Reschedule Booking
